Quite indeed... Quite indeed. Gawyn's entire sulking "if-she-doesn't-want-me-then-screw-her" combined with "But she needs me!" made him the most childlish character in the series in my own, not very humble opinion. He was not wrong in that every Aes Sedai needs a Warder - or five, if you're Green - to watch her back, but Egwene needed a reasonable, responsible Warder, like Lan to Moiraine or Gareth to Siuan - my other favourite couple - and not some fool who runs off and gets himself killed or publicly questions her, shortly followed by crying out in his sister's arms. What a pussy, if you excuse my frank ways. Light. I did not even mourn him. I even mourned Galad more (as I was convinced he was killed as the second son of Taringail to be defeated by Demandred). 

Androl and Pevara, however :3 *fangirl mode activated*
